relationship_to_v1: Supersedes the 2026-09-29 record (baseline_id src_core_conservation) as the current baseline for this target. It is a NEW comparison population, not a re-measurement: the test selection differs, so v1's 60/177 killed and this record's 152/177 killed must not be compared as a score change. v1 is kept unchanged as history.

run.source_note: origin/main at the time; the tests/ and tools/ files added in the same change were present in the scratch copy but do not import the target

tool.name: mutmut
tool.install: pip --target in a private scratch directory (optional dev tool, not a project dependency, shared venv untouched); the run used a scratch copy of the tree outside the repo with a cleared .mutmut-cache
tool.configuration: none in the repo (no setup.cfg or pyproject [mutmut] section); every option is on the command line below
tool.reproduction_command: cd <scratch copy of the tree>; PYTHONPATH=<scratch>/mutmut_pkg python <scratch>/mutmut_pkg/bin/mutmut run --paths-to-mutate src/core/conservation.py --runner "python -m pytest -x -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration/domains/adventure/test_harvest_to_event.py tests/integration/pipeline/test_transaction_completion.py tests/unit/combat/test_combat_matrix.py tests/unit/domains/adventure/test_craft_upgrade_execution.py tests/unit/economy/test_gold_sink.py tests/unit/resource/test_conservation_rejection_paths.py tests/unit/resource/test_durability_repair.py tests/unit/resource/test_node_charge_accounting.py tests/unit/resource/test_rejected_transfer_apply_path.py" --no-progress
tool.why_not_3x: mutmut 3.x trampoline rejects modules whose import path starts with 'src.'

selection.rule_description: tests/**/test_*.py (excluding tests/mutation/) that import the target module, or import a src/ module that itself imports the target directly; resolved by tools/test_architecture/mutation_selection.py
selection.curated_additions_reason: exercises the rejected-transfer apply path of the target without importing it directly (it was in the 2026-10-01 rerun's second pass)

known_exclusions.why: in v1's selection but matched by neither the rule nor a curated addition (reaches the target only through two or more hops or not at all by import); its contribution was not measured
in v1's selection but matched by neither the rule nor a curated addition (reaches the target only through two or more hops or not at all by import); its contribution was not measured
mutation records and reruns are data, excluded by the rule

selection.not_proof: an import-based rule is a reproducible starting point. It is not proof that every test relevant to the target is selected: dynamic imports, fixtures and paths of two or more hops are not found, and the end-to-end target-locked tests outside the selection (see the rerun record's observations) are not included

result_categories.equivalent: mutmut does not classify equivalent mutants; none were classified here

positive_control.reused_from: tests/mutation/reruns/src_core_conservation_rerun.json pass_1_positive_control (2026-10-01T02:53:26Z; reproduced v1's 177/60/117 on v1's 8 files)
positive_control.reuse_decision: reused, not re-run: all three equality checks hold

configuration.control: command line only: --paths-to-mutate src/core/conservation.py, runner `python -m pytest -x -q -p no:cacheprovider <files>`, --no-progress, cleared cache
configuration.v2: same options; only the runner's file list differs (the selection under measurement)

positive_control.scope: shows the tool and environment reproduce v1's counts on v1's selection; it does not validate v2's selection

target_selection.reason: atomic conservation law lives here (ResourceTransactionResolver.resolve); no commits touching it since 2026-07-02 and no open ticket names it

excluded.why: 2-3 line re-export shims; a run there would be near-vacuous
open P1 TCK-20260914-ITEM-REGISTRY-DUAL-CLASS-DIVERGENT-FAILURE-SEMANTICS names it as a consumer to change
